scope: Read-only source audit following the first public World startup timeout. No new runtime test or runtime change.
conclusion: No concrete missed-unlock race found; initial timeout remains unexplained and not reproduced.
findings: The access gate installs script load/error handlers before replacement and awaits each script; the World page orders the classic bootstrap before the module.
Unlock directly starts scripts. World entry mounts synchronously and does not depend on the earlier unlock event or DOMContentLoaded.
Shared shell readiness clears synchronously, independently of asynchronous IndexedDB initialization.
The fresh complete acceptance passed both routes using the same runner and public source pins.
limits: The failed original run did not capture startup-stage or request timing.
Empty request/error arrays in the diagnostic describe the successful reopen, not the original timeout.
Neither a network stall nor a harness cause is established. No runtime fix is justified by this audit.
